reviews.title: Novel design mechanics/ interesting BUT LEFT FOR DEAD
reviews.text:
The calendar is different and fun to see and use. Its design is very different yet pleasant. Lots of details. 

—-Going to use Time page now. 

BUT THIS APP IS FORGOTTEN AND KEFT AS DEAD. Years since last update. Others get no dev responses. 

Soon i can see that they may just shut it down. 

Usable for now. But no hope of a future. They abandoned the baby on the street. They had a great design.
